author: Cptnwhizbang
body: Beo will feel better in early t10. RS relies on both gear and skills that you don't have yet while Beonscales a lot with your follower. Beo also let's you use fully defensive skills so you stay alive and clear content. I would strong recommend Beo first.

author: petr1petr
body:
Beo is good idea - you can do well without too many items - and much better, if you have correct items. 

as fresh T10, you most likely dont have good equips. With fresh beo, you just need to focus on survival, so it is easier. You do need some pets, but that should not be a problem. 

if I were you, I would go beo first. 

also, make sure to check with your kingdom mates, if they have fey jorm scrolls or some other raids that could help you.
